// Fixture — should NOT be flagged.
//
// The func has the //nolint:cousinvalidator pragma in its doc
// comment immediately above. Thin-delegation rationale follows
// the marker as required.

package fixture

// isValidID wraps paths.IsValidID so existing call sites stay
// unchanged while the migration to the canonical surface lands.
//
//nolint:cousinvalidator — thin delegation to paths.IsValidID
func isValidID(id string) bool {
	// real impl would call paths.IsValidID(id) == nil
	return id != ""
}
